name: sitebox
description: A PWA library for your websites on Cloudflare Workers + R2: upload HTML/folders/zips or push from VS Code, open them anywhere, even offline.

scripts.setup: wrangler r2 bucket create sitebox && wrangler secret put SITEBOX_TOKEN
scripts.seed: node cli/sitebox.js push sites/builders-quest -n builders-quest -m "Bundled site"
scripts.push:quest: node cli/sitebox.js push sites/builders-quest -n builders-quest -m "Update Builder's Quest"
